name: Voice Fundamental Frequency
description: Analyzes voice F0 (fundamental frequency) patterns — voice cloning often has unnatural F0 contours.
mechanism:
This method analyzes voice fundamental frequency (F0) for deepfake detection:

1. **F0提取**: The fundamental frequency (pitch) of the voice is extracted per frame using autocorrelation, cepstral, or YIN algorithm. F0 corresponds to the vocal fold vibration rate, typically 85-180 Hz for males and 165-255 Hz for females.

2. **F0轮廓分析**: The temporal F0 contour (pitch track) is analyzed for naturalness. Natural speech shows characteristic F0 patterns: (a) declination (gradual F0 decrease across utterances), (b) prosodic contours (rises for questions, falls for statements), (c) micro-prosody (F0 perturbations at phoneme boundaries). AI voice synthesis may produce F0 contours with incorrect prosodic patterns or missing micro-prosodic detail.

3. **F0RangeandVariability**: Each speaker has a characteristic F0 range and variability. The method checks whether F0 statistics (mean, standard deviation, range) fall within physiologically plausible values for the apparent speaker. AI-generated voices may show either unnaturally constrained (monotone) or excessive F0 variability.

4. **JitterandShimmer**: Natural voice shows slight cycle-to-cycle F0 variation (jitter, typically <1%) and amplitude variation (shimmer, typically <3%). These micro-perturbations reflect the biomechanics of vocal fold vibration. AI voice synthesis may produce either too-perfect (zero jitter/shimmer) or incorrectly modeled perturbation patterns.

5. **F0-视觉相关性**: Voice F0 should correlate with visible physical effort — higher pitch may correspond with increased tension visible in the neck muscles. The method checks audio-visual F0 correspondence. Deepfakes combining generated audio with generated video may show poor F0-visual correlation.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
